prompts.covers: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium original board-game cover illustration atlas for Mocha Tabletop. Create ONE square 1536x1536 image as a precise 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX paintings, equal edge-to-edge rectangular tiles, no gutters or borders. Each tile is portrait 2:3. Match the reference image's lush painterly realism, warm cinematic lamplight, deep forest-green shadows, intricate brass/wood textures, rich atmospheric detail. It is a STYLE reference only: do not copy the giant gemstone. Top row left: a beautiful inviting sushi banquet, meticulously painted salmon nigiri, dumplings and maki on ceramic plates in a lantern-lit Japanese restaurant. Top row middle: a spice caravan of camels and travelling merchants entering a magnificent warm sandstone bazaar, bowls of saffron and spices in foreground. Top row right: four ornate playing cards floating dynamically above a green felt tabletop, jewel-red, sapphire-blue, emerald-green and ochre-yellow ribbons of light and gilded filigree, blank faces with elegant abstract geometry and NO numbers or words. Bottom row left: an atmospheric secret agent's desk with sealed cream dossiers, dark red and blue wax seals, brass spyglass, lamplit rainy window. Bottom row middle: a mysterious masquerade invitation with two beautiful half masks, plum-purple velvet, a sealed envelope and lantern bokeh, an intimate mystery evening. Bottom row right: a welcoming richly textured green tabletop with a tiny caramel-colored fluffy dog beside dice and a warm brass lamp. Compose one strong readable focal subject centered within EACH tile. Keep all objects inside their tile. Fully painted original illustration, NOT flat icons, NOT emoji, NOT a UI mockup. No letters, no text, no labels, no watermark.
prompts.sushi: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original illustrated food card atlas for a high-quality tabletop game. ONE 1536x1152 image, precise FOUR columns by THREE rows, TWELVE equally-sized SQUARE illustrations, edge-to-edge with no gutters, borders, labels or text. Each tile depicts one centrally arranged food serving against a softly painted warm charcoal ceramic/wood tabletop, suitable for cropping directly as a card painting. Cozy exquisite painterly realism, sumptuous natural ingredients, warm restaurant lamplight, delicate brush texture, original artwork. Reference is only for level of painterly polish and material richness, NOT the gemstone subject. Exact row-major order: row1 col1 two golden shrimp tempura with green garnish; col2 three slices of fresh red tuna sashimi on dark ceramic; col3 three delicate steamed dumplings; col4 one nori-wrapped maki roll showing rice and cucumber. Row2 col1 two nori-wrapped maki rolls; col2 three nori-wrapped maki rolls; col3 one yellow tamago egg nigiri tied with black nori; col4 one orange salmon nigiri over rice. Row3 col1 one ivory squid nigiri on rice with a fine nori strip; col2 a small elegant mound of green wasabi on a dark dish; col3 one golden custard pudding with glossy caramel sauce on a plate; col4 a graceful pair of dark wooden chopsticks on a ceramic rest, no food. Precise count for maki tiles important. Every tile centered, good margin around its main object, no cut-off food, beautiful coherent palette. No faces, no emoji, no flat symbols, no text or numerals anywhere.
prompts.century: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original merchant and spice-order card painting atlas for a premium board game. ONE 1536x1024 image, precise THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX equally sized SQUARE paintings, no gutters or borders. Rich painterly realism, intricate brass, linen and sandstone materials, golden light and dark teal shadows, warm trade-route atmosphere. Reference shows desired quality only, NOT gemstone subject. Exact row-major scenes: top left an inviting spice seller stall with vivid turmeric, red saffron, green cardamom and brown cinnamon displayed in bowls; top middle a travelling merchant with a laden camel and fine patterned rugs near ancient sandstone arches; top right an artisan carefully grinding and sorting spices in a brass mortar by a sunlit workshop window. Bottom left a sailing merchant ship carrying sacks and barrels at an old harbor at sunset; bottom middle a luxurious trade contract scene, rolled parchment and brass scales weighing spice sacks, no writing visible; bottom right a grand caravan arriving at a desert city's majestic gate under warm evening light. Each tile is its own complete scene with main subject centered and clear silhouettes at card size. Fully detailed painted narrative artwork, NOT emoji/icons. No text, no logos, no watermark, no letters, no numerals.
